source: Thronefall wiki (throne-fall.github.io, the official community wiki), Oct 2026. Costs in gold; income is paid each morning by buildings that survived the night. Damage multiplies by every matching tag of the target (e.g. tower base 8 x 1.15 vs flying).

buildings.name: Castle Center
buildings.notes: Lose if destroyed. Each upgrade offers a pick of 1 from 4 (L2: Royal Training, Builder's Guild, Magic Armor, Assassin's Training; L3: Royal Mastery, Commander, Castle-Up, Godly Curse)

buildings.name: Mill
buildings.notes: Unlocks fields. Pick 1 of 4 on building: Improved Plow (+1 income per later upgrade), Explosive Trap (explodes when destroyed), Scarecrows (anti-air on its fields), Wind Spirits (block enemy arrows nearby)

buildings.name: Fishing Harbour
buildings.incomePerNight: 1 per boat (2 at L2); gains a boat each night, up to 5

buildings.name: Tower
buildings.notes: L2 pick: Castle (+150 HP, faster), Sniper (+50% range, +180% damage, targets highest HP and siege), Armoured (+350 HP, targets lowest HP or flying, shield on first hit), Bunker (+75 HP, random target). L3 pick: Archer's Spire (+1 arrow), Ballistic Spire (+450% damage, slows), Fire Spire (splash and oil), Healing Spire (heals allies)

buildings.name: Barricade
buildings.notes: 0 HP but indestructible; slows enemies, doesn't block

buildings.name: Barracks
buildings.respawn: 10 s / 6 s / 6 s during the night, all at dawn
buildings.notes: Pick one unit type for good: Knights, Spearmen, Flails, Berserks

buildings.name: Archery Range
buildings.notes: Pick one: Longbow Archers, Crossbowmen, Hunters, Fire Archers

buildings.name: Blacksmith (Royal Forge)
buildings.notes: Each level: pick 1 of 4 researches that buff everything: melee +20% (3 days), ranged +20% (3 days), melee resistance +30% (2 days), ranged resistance +30% (2 days)

buildings.name: Shrine
buildings.notes: Must be activated by killing 350 HP of enemies near it; then shoots and pays 2 gold a night; +20% per other active shrine

buildings.name: Hero's Quarters
buildings.notes: One hero unit (Golem, Firewing, Lizard Rider, Support Mage) that grows stronger with upgrades instead of more numerous

units.name: Spearman
units.notes: x1.75 damage vs fast enemies and slows them 67% for 2 s

units.name: Berserk
units.notes: Targets siege units and other high-HP targets

units.name: Crossbowman
units.notes: Short range, high damage, bonus vs ranged units, weak vs flying

units.name: Hunter
units.notes: x2 vs monsters, +40% range vs monsters, a melee attack too; weak vs ranged

units.name: Support Mage
units.notes: Heals the king and units, blocks magic projectiles

units.name: The King
units.notes: Regenerates 10%/s after 1 s; the only builder; weapon chosen before the map (bow and dagger, spear, sword, lightning staff)

enemies.name: Pikes
enemies.notes: Slow and hurt the king's horse when ridden into

enemies.name: Racer
enemies.notes: x2 vs castle, resists the king, never chases the king

enemies.name: Exploder
enemies.notes: Dies attacking a building and explodes

enemies.name: Catapult
enemies.notes: x0.2 vs castle centre; never targets the king

enemies.name: Quicksling
enemies.notes: High damage, shoots at random targets in range

enemies.name: Shadow in the Water / Strange Statues
